content.simple_explanation: To learn New Beginnings: Cities and States, first understand the main idea, then identify supporting evidence/examples or steps, and finally apply the idea.
key_points: 4 CHAPTER New Beginnings: Cities and States The kingdom shall be protected by fortifying the capital and the towns at the frontiers.
The land should not only be capable of sustaining the population but also outsiders in times of calamities.
It should be beautiful, being endowed with cultivable land, mines, timber forests, elephant forests, and good pastures rich in cattle.
It should have a productive economy, with a wide variety of commodities ….
Ruins of a major structure at Rājagṛiha (modern-day Rajgir in Bihar), when it was the capital of the Magadha mahājanapada.
Why were the janapadas and mahājanapadas an important development in India’s early history?
